hypothesis: The four-body star is the cubic monomial suggested by a formal Schrieffer-Wolff expansion of a transverse field around a uniform classical bound built from J alone. That motivation is a hypothesis. This run does not solve a Schrieffer-Wolff effective Hamiltonian, does not claim the series is controlled at the entropy peak, and does not fix theta_C to a perturbative value. Theta is a free shared energy-fit coefficient in front of an explicitly normalized J-polynomial feature.

gauge_audit.note: Unwrap is applied only to controls whose pi/2 (shell) or pi (beta) shift left the energy unchanged on random D/QAOA states. Gamma is not given a period.

optimizer.fidelity: post-hoc only; best-E state is kept, not best-F
optimizer.nested_inits: Richer models replace up to two of their random starts with the same-depth simpler model (new coefficients set to 0). The start count does not increase. QAOA rescue includes a projection of the winning shell's c1 onto beta.

polish: Cells with gradient norm above 1e-3 were continued with L-BFGS-B maxiter 400, maxfun 4000. nfev_sum includes that continuation.
